core_identity.what_it_sells: Decorative aur industrial paints, wood finishes, waterproofing solutions, wall coverings, adhesives, aur home decor segment ke tahat bath fittings, kitchen fittings, lighting, aur furnishing products bechti hai.
core_identity.who_is_customer: Retail consumers (B2C) gharo ke liye, painting contractors, architects, interior designers, aur automotive/industrial sectors ke OEMs (B2B).

revenue_breakdown.segment_disclosure_note: Segment reporting audited financial statements me Paints aur Home Decor ke roop me di jati hai, jisme domestic paints major share hold karta hai.

revenue_drivers: Volume growth demand in decorative paints and network expansion of Beautiful Homes stores
Real estate activity, housing completions, and consumer shift towards waterproofing and premium finishes
Raw material price movements (crude oil derivatives like TiO2 and monomers) affecting pricing power and gross margins

must_watch_metrics.why_track: Volume growth demand aur market share gains ko track karne ke liye sabse important metric hai.
Crude-based raw material inflation aur price hikes ka impact direct operating profitability par reflect hota hai.

core_risks.description: Crude oil prices aur petrochemical derivatives me tezi aane se company ki gross margins par dabav padta hai.
Naye unorganized aur well-funded organized players (jaise Grasim ki entry) ki wajah se pricing pressure aur market share risk badh raha hai.

core_identity.what_it_sells: Reliance ka core business multiple verticals mein divided hai: O2C (Oil-to-Chemicals) jisme refining aur petrochemical products jaise polymers, polyesters aur fuels beche jaate hain; Digital Services (Jio) jisme 4G/5G telecom data, voice aur digital apps services hain; Retail jisme grocery, consumer electronics aur fashion ki physical aur online stores se selling hoti hai; aur Oil & Gas (E&P) jisme KG-D6 basin se natural gas aur CBM ka extraction aur sale hota hai.
core_identity.who_is_customer: B2B aur B2C dono. O2C aur Oil & Gas segment mein industrial clients, B2B manufacturers aur bulk buyers customer hain. Digital Services aur Retail mein retail consumers, households aur small businesses (SMEs) direct end-users hain.

revenue_breakdown.segment_disclosure_note: Audited segment results ke mutabik segment revenue gross turnover aur inter-segment transfers ke sath report ki jati hai.

revenue_drivers: O2C segment mein GRMs (Gross Refining Margins) aur downstream petrochemical product spreads ka movement
Jio ke ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) mein growth aur data consumption volume mein izafa
Retail segment mein store expansion, footfalls, aur non-grocery categories ki sales penetration

must_watch_metrics.why_track: Ye refining business ki profitability aur global product cracks ke sath company ki earnings ko directly drive karta hai
Ye telecom subscriber base se monetization ki efficiency aur per-user revenue generation ko measure karta hai

must_watch_metrics.metric: Retail Area Expansion & Revenue per Sq. Ft.
must_watch_metrics.why_track: Ye retail segment ki operational efficiency aur store productivity ka key indicator hai

core_risks.description: Crude oil aur gas prices mein international fluctuations hone se O2C aur Exploration margins par direct pressure padta hai
Export duties, windfall taxes, aur telecom sector regulations (TRAI/DoT guidelines) mein badlaav se profitability affect ho sakti hai

core_identity.what_it_sells: HDFC Bank retail aur wholesale banking products bechti hai, jisme savings/current accounts, retail loans (auto, housing, personal), credit cards, wholesale/corporate lending, aur treasury operations shamil hain.
core_identity.who_is_customer: Retail individual customers, MSMEs, large corporates, agricultural sector, aur government entities iske primary customers hain.

revenue_breakdown.segment_disclosure_note: Audited financial statements ke anusar, bank ke main segments Treasury, Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, aur Other Banking Operations hain.

revenue_drivers: Loan portfolio growth (Retail aur Wholesale advances ki volume)
Net Interest Margin (NIM) jo cost of funds aur yield on advances par depend karta hai
Fee income jo credit cards, cross-selling, aur third-party products (mutual funds/insurance) se aati hai

must_watch_metrics.why_track: Low-cost current account aur savings account deposits bank ki funding cost ko kam karte hain aur NIM ko protect karte hain.

must_watch_metrics.metric: Gross NPA and Net NPA Ratio
must_watch_metrics.why_track: Asset quality track karne ke liye zaroori hai taaki pata chale kitna loan default ho raha hai aur kitna provisioning karni padegi.

core_risks.description: Agar interest rates badhte hain aur bank apne deposit rates jaldi reprice karta hai jabki loans fix hain, toh margins par dabav aa sakta hai.
Retail aur corporate segment me economic slowdown ya job losses ki wajah se defaults badh sakte hain, jisse credit cost upar ja sakti hai.

sources.title: HDFC Bank Limited Annual Report FY2023-24

core_identity.what_it_sells: TCS global clients ko IT services, consulting, aur digital transformation solutions bechti hai, jisme cloud computing, cybersecurity, enterprise software implementation, aur artificial intelligence services shaamil hain.
core_identity.who_is_customer: B2B customers, jisme global Fortune 500 companies, banking & financial services, retail, healthcare, manufacturing, aur telecom sectors ke large enterprises aate hain.

revenue_breakdown.segment_disclosure_note: Segments are disclosed based on industry verticals and geographical markets in the audited financial statements.

revenue_drivers: Order Book aur Total Contract Value (TCV) conversions jo large multi-year deals se aate hain
Digital transformation aur cloud migration projects ki demand
Client wallet share expansion aur existing key accounts me cross-selling

must_watch_metrics.why_track: Pricing power, cost optimization, aur employee pyramid efficiency ko reflect karta hai jo direct bottom-line profitability drive karta hai.
Employee retention costs, hiring expenses, aur talent availability ko track karne ke liye critical hai kyunki labor cost sabse bada expense hai.

must_watch_metrics.metric: Total Contract Value (TCV) of Deal Wins
must_watch_metrics.why_track: Future revenue visibility aur medium-term growth trajectory ka leading indicator hai.

core_risks.description: Developed markets (jaise US aur Europe) me agar economic slowdown ya inflation hota hai, toh clients IT spending aur discretionary projects cut kar dete hain.
Revenue majorly USD, GBP, aur EUR me aata hai jabki cost INR me hoti hai; exchange rate me sharp volatility margins ko impact karti hai.

core_identity.what_it_sells: Yeh company passenger vehicles (entry-level hatchbacks, compact cars, sedans, SUVs, and vans), spare parts, accessories, aur pre-owned car business (True Value) bechti hai, saath mein vehicle servicing aur maintenance bhi provide karti hai.
core_identity.who_is_customer: Customer profile mainly B2C (individual retail buyers for personal mobility) aur B2B/commercial segments (fleet operators, aggregators, aur government departments) ko cover karta hai, along with export markets globally.

revenue_breakdown.segment_disclosure_note: As per Ind AS 108 Segment Reporting in Audited Financial Statements, the company operates primarily in a single business segment being Passenger Vehicles and allied services.

revenue_drivers: Domestic passenger vehicle sales volume aur new SUV launches
Export volumes across international markets (Africa, Middle East, Latin America, and Asia)
Spare parts, accessories, and value-added services (insurance and financing commissions)

must_watch_metrics.why_track: Yeh manufacturing efficiency aur fixed cost absorption ko determine karta hai jo operating margins ko directly impact karta hai.
Yeh raw material price volatility (steel, aluminum, precious metals) aur discounting intensity ke baad core profitability dikhata hai.

core_risks.description: Steel, aluminum, aur precious metals ke daam badhne se gross margins par pressure aa sakta hai agar cost increase poori tarah customer ko pass on na kiya jaye.
Semiconductor chips ya critical electronic components ki shortage se production lines affect ho sakti hain aur waiting periods badh sakte hain.

core_identity.what_it_sells: Polycab wires aur cables, FMEG (fast moving electrical goods jaise fans, lighting, switches, aur appliances), aur solar products ya conduits bechti hai.
core_identity.who_is_customer: Yeh B2B (institutional clients, infrastructure projects, industrial buyers) aur B2C (retail consumers, electricians, builders) dono segments ko cater karti hai.

revenue_breakdown.segment_disclosure_note: Segments are officially disclosed in audited financial statements under Ind AS 108 Operating Segments.

revenue_drivers: Volume growth in infrastructure, real estate, and industrial capex driving wire and cable demand
Raw material price volatility management (copper and aluminium passing through to end-users)
Expansion of retail distribution network and dealer reach across Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities

must_watch_metrics.why_track: Tracks profitability trends in the core Wires & Cables business versus the FMEG business turnaround
Indicates volume growth trajectory and manufacturing scale efficiency across plants

core_risks.description: Copper aur aluminium ke daamon mein sharp volatility se gross margins par direct impact padta hai agar price pass-on mein delay ho.
FMEG segment mein losses ko reduce karna aur market share badhana ek bada execution risk hai intense competition ke beech.
